## About
- Computer Engineering undergraduate, IOE Pulchowk Campus (Apr 2023 – present)
- Based in Ekantakuna, Lalitpur, Nepal
- AI/ML Intern at Layman AI (May 2026 – present), working on real-time
  computer vision pipelines (YOLOv8, MediaPipe) and FastAPI inference services
- Secretary, IT Club Pulchowk (Jun 2025 – Jun 2026) — manages Docker/Coolify
  deployments on a self-hosted server, organizes workshops and hackathons
- Fellow, Seeds for Future (Jun–Jul 2025) — training in AI, 5G, cloud infrastructure
- Interested in ML/AI engineering roles and internships

## Skills
- Languages: Python, C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL
- AI/ML: Deep Learning, CNNs, RNN/LSTM/GRU, Transformers & Attention, NLP,
  RAG, LLM Fine-Tuning (QLoRA/PEFT), Computer Vision, Feature Engineering
- ML & Data: PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, Hugging Face,
  LangChain, NumPy, Pandas, OpenCV, librosa
- Backend & Web: FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, Express, React.js, React Native
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, ChromaDB, pgvector, Redis
- Tools/MLOps: Docker, Git, Coolify, Streamlit, Jupyter

## Projects
- **Network Anomaly Detection in Named Data Networking** (ongoing research,
  under Prof. Babu Ram Dhawadi) — unsupervised anomaly detection
  (Isolation Forest) for Interest Flooding and Cache Pollution attacks in
  NDN; 100% attacker detection, ~1s latency, 0% false-positive rate,
  validated on ns-3/ndnSIM and live miniNDN/NFD.
- **English–Nepali Neural Machine Translation** — Transformer built from
  scratch in PyTorch, 35M parameters, trained on 1M sentence pairs from
  Meta AI's NLLB corpus; 13.8 BLEU / 41.2 ChrF on FLORES-200.
- **Kanun Sathi** — RAG-based AI legal assistant answering Nepali legal
  questions with page-level citations; FastAPI + pgvector + Gemini 2.5
  Flash, React/TypeScript frontend, Dockerized full stack.
- **ragchatbot** — open-source, pip-installable RAG SDK (PyPI, v1.1.3)
  turning a document folder into a semantic-search chatbot API;
  multi-LLM support (Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama), ChromaDB store.
- **Nagarik Suchana** — bilingual civic-tech platform (React Native,
  Node.js, PostgreSQL) connecting citizens with local government; OCR +
  Gemini pipeline extracting structured fields from government notices.
- **Infant Cry Detection** — TensorFlow LSTM/ANN audio classifier for
  infant cries using MFCC features; deployed via Flask API and a
  React Native/Expo app with on-device TensorFlow Lite inference.
